config.cluster_id: centroid lexicographic order; minimum member SHA breaks ties
config.selection: unused package first; representative nearest centroid; diverse/third max-min within cluster; coverage_fill lowest selected/population ratio
config.cluster_visit_order: distinct package count ascending, cluster ID ascending
config.scope: coverage sampling only; no labels or predictions
config.freeze_policy: refuse existing membership or metadata; never replace APK for tool failure/no path/unknown

lineage_limit: 同 package 或明確 canonical lineage 的傳遞閉包；未推斷未知跨 package 關係，不以 certificate 單獨推定 lineage。
package_uniqueness_limit: 以 package novelty 優先的 deterministic heuristic；若結果為 50 個 package，即達到 50 APK 的 uniqueness 上限。
membership_hash_definition: SHA256 of canonical JSON sorted SHA256 list; excludes freeze timestamp
determinism_scope: 固定輸入內容、config、seed 與已記錄 numerical library versions；候選先依 SHA 排序，數值單執行緒。CSV timestamp 不屬於 membership identity。
